claim.text: A redaction save that flattens a region purges, from every /Properties dictionary the flattened page reached (its own /Resources object, a /Properties object its own /Resources named, the /Resources a kept page received from its /Parent chain, the /Resources of every stream and Type 3 font it reached), every entry that no BDC or DP operator of the content the usage analysis reads names (inline dictionaries and references), and keeps the entries kept content names with their text. residual_in_region adds 1 (NotProven::ResidualInRegion, region_flattened false) for: a reached /Properties dictionary whose usage is undetermined (unreadable scope content, incomplete analysis), a reached dictionary the purge cannot edit (stream or alias spelling) with an unnamed entry whose property list holds /Alt /ActualText /E /T or /Lang, and each such property list of the old page left live (another object references it) that no kept content names. With a flattened region, check_document also counts a /Type or /S past the reader's 16-hop bound, a stream with /N and /First read as an object stream whatever its /Type, object-stream bytes that are not white space, comments, header pairs or members, and structure shapes in the saved trailer.

notes.plr_107_claim_text: Reworded claim of SMB-PRESS-STRUCT-FAILCLOSED (PLR-107, R22 V-1; lead: reword in the next press lane record): 'A redaction save that flattens at least one region and whose saved document still has a structure tree (a /StructTreeRoot the catalog holds, directly or through a chain of references, or any /StructParents or /StructParent entry left in the file) reads region_flattened false and reports NotProven::ResidualInRegion, residual_in_region + 1 once; a save with no region applies none of these rules (PLR-101). The redaction proof covers untagged documents; for tagged documents the structure tree is neutralized best effort and reported.' (The SMB-PRESS-STRUCT-FAILCLOSED lane file itself is not edited: not owned by this lane.)
notes.behaviour_change: painted_source_referenced_by_a_key_of_a_drawn_object_is_reported, row 'an undrawn form (/Properties) whose content draws it': before, the /Properties entry was a plain reference, the image stayed and was reported (PaintedSourceKept); now /Properties is gated, the entry is reached only when kept content names it, so the image is dropped (its entry in the form's /XObject pruned like any unused source) and nothing is reported (SCAN-PIXELS-SECRET gone, region_flattened true). The direct case (painted_source_referenced_but_not_drawn_by_a_kept_page_is_reported: page two's own /Properties names the image) is unchanged: the unnamed entry is not in a reached dictionary, its reference keeps the image live, reported.
residuals_fail_closed: usage undetermined (kept scope content that does not parse, incomplete analysis): counted, every entry stays
/Resources or /Properties written as a stream or reached through an alias object: not edited; counted when an unnamed entry's property list holds a text key
a property list object of the old page kept live by another reference while no kept content names it: counted when it holds a text key
a /Type or /S chain past 16 hops, a stream with /N and /First that is not an object stream, object-stream gaps: counted (over-report accepted)
residuals_not_counted: an unnamed property list whose text is under a key other than /Alt /ActualText /E /T /Lang and that stays only through an unedited (stream/alias) dictionary or another reference
property lists in /Properties dictionaries the flattened page never reached (kept pages' own) are not purged: not part of the old page
an entry named by kept content keeps its text (kept content invokes it), also when the flattened page named it too
